title: Data export
description: Send logs, audit events and metrics to the tools you already run. Everything is opt-in, bounded in memory, and never slows a deploy.
notConfigured: Data export is not available on this control plane.

empty.title: No export destinations
empty.description: Add a Loki, syslog or HTTP endpoint for logs, a webhook or bucket for the audit log, or an OTLP collector for metrics.

scrape.title: Prometheus scrape endpoint
scrape.description: Point Prometheus or Grafana Agent at this path with a read token as the bearer credential. Labels are limited to app, database and node.

kinds.audit_s3: Audit log to a storage bucket

card.deleteDescription: Delivery stops and its stored credentials are removed. Data already delivered stays where it is.
card.behind: Behind: deliveries are failing, audit rows wait safely in the log

fix.title: Test failed
fix.bad_token: The collector rejected the token. Paste a valid one and test again.
fix.tls_error: The collector's certificate is not trusted. Install a trusted certificate, or accept this one if you control the collector.
fix.unreachable: The collector could not be reached. Check the address, the port and any firewall between the two.
fix.rejected: The collector refused the request. Check the index, source and endpoint path.
fix.private_blocked: This control plane blocks internal addresses. An operator can allow them with APP_EXPORT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=true, then test again.
fix.trustCert: Accept this certificate and test again
fix.trustWarning: Skips certificate verification for this destination. Anyone on the path can read or alter the audit log in transit.

form.title: Add export destination
form.description: Credentials are encrypted at rest and never shown again.
form.name: Name
form.remoteWriteKeyHint: Sent as basic auth with a username, as a bearer token without. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.headers: Request headers, one per line as Name: value
form.headersHint: For example Authorization or X-Scope-OrgID. Stored encrypted.
form.hmacHint: Each batch carries an HMAC signature header so the receiver can verify it.
form.storageTargetNone: No storage destination is connected yet. Add one under Storage destinations first.
form.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Create a key that can only ingest logs.
form.endpointOverride: Leave blank to use the vendor endpoint
form.hecTokenHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Use a token limited to one index.
form.insecureWarning: Unsafe: the audit log can be read or altered in transit. Use only for a collector you control.
form.auditStreamHint: Delivery is at least once and resumes from where it stopped. Each event carries the audit hash chain fields so the receiver can verify the log.
